comment: Device Hub Pro Controls inspector (Device Hub's device-settings panel) pixel-parity reference, top-of-panel state. Values are audited against a saved 2x capture (DH 27.0, 2x, window inactive; key-state colours derived through the audited relative deltas) and documented in ParityMetrics.swift CT-01…CT-09 and Sources/DeviceHubProApp/ParityMetrics.swift. Coordinates are window points from the capture's top-left. PREREQUISITE: the app runs with DHP_CONTROLS_EXPAND_ALL=1, the Controls inspector is open (toolbar sliders button) on a device whose first card is Network with Wi-Fi / Bluetooth / Airplane mode / Mobile data / Data Saver / Wi-Fi verbose logging / Mobile data always active (e.g. the Pixel 9 Pro Fold emulator on Android 17; images that still offer Wi-Fi scan throttling add an eighth row and move ct-group-card-gap down 43 pt), the panel is at the top of its scroll, and no sheet is up. The value-popup and slider rows now live in the collapsed-by-default Display & sound group; their geometry is checked separately against a saved 2x capture with Scripts/parity-reference-controls-display.json. The seeded parity-reference.json assumes the Apps tab, so the files are run separately.

checks.name: ct-card-top
checks.description: First settings card top edge: 8 pt below the 52 pt toolbar band plus the Network heading (13 pt) and its 7 pt gap (CT-01; DH's first card 60 pt, which has no heading). (2026-09-28: the group title is a heading above the card, so the card starts 20 pt lower and its first row is Wi-Fi.)
